about: HERESY 1553: the Refiner's pipelines the studio ships (Viktor 18.10.2026: «сотвори несколько профилей пайплайна… для Про и Паблик»). Each is the chain's steps in their order; the page lists them beside the profiles one saves. A plugin may bring its own in its plugin.json («pipelines»).

pipelines.name: Quick polish
pipelines.tip: The take as it is, its frame buzz out and remastered whole; no stems. A few minutes.

pipelines.name: Song: stems and remaster
pipelines.say: eight stems, the lead whole, remaster
pipelines.tip: Debuzzed, split into eight stems, the lead voice made whole where the split lost it to the backing, remastered from the mended stems with the balanced preset, its top drawn anew at the end, then looked for faults.

pipelines.name: Song: my DAW mix
pipelines.say: eight stems, the lead whole, mixed as the DAW is set
pipelines.tip: As «Song: stems and remaster», but mixed by the DAW as its strips are set now (levels, pans, cuts, sends, the master chain) instead of the remaster's preset; the remaster then brings it to loudness.

pipelines.name: Song: full air
pipelines.say: the top redrawn before the split and on the voices
pipelines.tip: As «Song: stems and remaster», with the take's top drawn anew before the split and the voices' own after it: the most air the studio gives. The longest of them: three upscales on a card.

pipelines.name: Warm tape
pipelines.say: mixed, then through tape at 30 ips
pipelines.tip: Eight stems, the lead whole, mixed as the DAW is set now, printed through the Digital Gateway's master tape at 30 ips, then remastered.

pipelines.name: Spoken word
pipelines.say: voice forward, sibilants tamed, the words checked
pipelines.tip: For readings: debuzzed, split into voice and music, the voice's top drawn anew, remastered with the voice forward and the de-esser on, then every word heard against the text.

pipelines.name: Look only
pipelines.tip: The take looked at and nothing made from it: its faults, its spectrum and its words.

pipelines.name: Voices: subtle
pipelines.say: the bundle averaged above 12 kHz, a little under
pipelines.tip: The voices' top drawn by the three upscalers and averaged above 12 kHz, 2 dB under as drawn: the gentlest, as SUNO's subtle remaster. Then the DAW's mix and the Remaster.

pipelines.name: Voices: normal
pipelines.tip: The voices' top drawn by the three upscalers and averaged above 12 kHz, as drawn: the balance measured closest to a voice's own top. Then the DAW's mix and the Remaster.

pipelines.name: Voices: high
pipelines.tip: The voices redrawn from 8 kHz, averaged: for a voice the split left dull. Then the DAW's mix and the Remaster.

pipelines.name: Voices: air
pipelines.say: averaged to 16 kHz, the loudest above
pipelines.tip: The bundle averaged up to 16 kHz and the loudest of the three above it: breath and air over a calm presence. Then the DAW's mix and the Remaster.

pipelines.name: Voices: bright
pipelines.say: the loudest of the three in each cell
pipelines.tip: The loudest of the three upscalers in each cell above 12 kHz, 2 dB under: the brightest; for a voice buried in the band. Then the DAW's mix and the Remaster.
